paper.title: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
paper.authors: David D. Dai, Yen-Ting Lin, Marin Soljačić

results.system_description: 2D electron gas, N = 91 fully polarized electrons, r_s = 30, 60-degree rhombic (triangular-lattice) periodic cell, Gamma point
results.variant: TorFormer, translation-equivariant transformer (about 200K parameters), 8K training steps
results.source_location: Table (tab:n91_comparison), N = 91, r_s = 30, row TorFormer, column (E - E_Mad.) r_s^(3/2) / N [Ha.]
results.eligibility_evidence: 'Table compares final inference energies for TorFormer' (Results); inference energies are 'estimated from fresh Markov chains' (Fig. 1 caption). The paper's own NQS variational energy.
results.notes: Convention: the paper prints (E - E_Mad) r_s^(3/2) / N, with E_Mad 'the trivial Madelung part' (the classical electrostatic energy of the triangular Wigner crystal in the cell) subtracted and not printed. The board value is token x convention_factor + convention_offset, with convention_factor = r_s^(-3/2) = 30^(-3/2) and convention_offset = E_Mad/N = M/r_s, M = -1.1061025867 Ha bohr the Ewald (Madelung) energy per electron x r_s of the commensurate triangular crystal with a neutralizing background (1/r interaction), computed for the 91-site 60-degree rhombic cell in all three orientations (m, n) = (5, 6), (6, 5), (1, 9) and for the 1- and 7-site cells, independent of the Ewald splitting to 1e-12 (Kuma job 4758253, 2026-11-02). Check: the same table quotes Psiformer+SWPA (Gaggioli et al.) as 0.810485(5), and Ketboard holds their -0.03193763(3) (arXiv:2607.08616v2) for this instance; together they imply E_Mad/N = -0.036870084634, 1.6e-9 from the Ewald value, within their uncertainty (about 3e-8); the implied M is the same at r_s = 30 and 40 (1/r_s scaling). The SJB+DMC row converts to the DMC reference of 2607.08616v2 on this instance. Simulation cell: lattice vectors of equal length at 60 degrees (Results), N = 91 = m^2 + mn + n^2 commensurate with the crystal, spin-polarized; the error bar's meaning is not stated. The SJB+DMC and PF+SWPA rows are quoted values and are not recorded.
